US, Mexico, Bolivia Lose Measles-Free Status Amid Rising Deaths

The United States, Mexico, and Bolivia have lost their measles-free status due to a rise in cases and deaths. This decline is attributed to falling vaccination rates in the US. The specific number of deaths or cases was not provided in the coverage.
